clips.title: 100 People Age 1 to 100 — Scaffolding Opening Hook
clips.dialogue: These 100 people aged 1 to 100 are competing for ,000! Whoever stays in their circle the longest wins! Right now the 100-year-old is having tea with the 1-year-old, and in this video people are going to cry, make alliances, get betrayed, and a whole lot of weird stuff. But to start off the challenge easily, I got everyone a box of pizza. Enjoy!

clips.creator: MrBeast
clips.title: Day 7 Red Tesla Model 3 Challenge
clips.dialogue: To celebrate an entire week inside of this circle, I decided to give them a challenge with a Tesla as a prize! Who wants the Tesla?! The boys are rolling out a special tarp! Now all of you can walk on this thing right here. If you can ride this and touch the Tesla without touching the ground, I will let you keep it!

clips.creator: MrBeast
clips.title: Final Emotional Payoff — ,000 Winner
clips.dialogue: Wait, you just won ,000, how do you feel?! I can finally take my daughters to Disney World and I can buy a house and I can pay off all of my debt. You literally just changed my life.
